# UtilityPot

> Open-source tools for data, text, diagrams and planning. 11 tools: 8 browser-local workflows and 3 bounded AI workflows after explicit consent. People review interpretations; deterministic application code validates and executes exact operations.

Canonical live origin: https://utilitypot.modepot.io/
Source: https://github.com/tugrulguner/utilitypot
Family: https://modepot.io/
Creator: https://tugrul.modepot.io/
License: MIT

## Tools
- [Screenshot to spreadsheet](https://utilitypot.modepot.io/tools/screenshot-to-spreadsheet/): Recognize a clear printed English table locally, review editable cells against the source and copy/download CSV or text-preserving XLSX. Browser-local; no image upload or AI API. OCR and row alignment require review.
- [Redact a screenshot](https://utilitypot.modepot.io/tools/redact-screenshot/): Manually cover selected regions with opaque black pixels and download a newly encoded PNG. Browser-local; no image upload. Inspect the entire export; unselected sensitive content remains visible.
- [Compare spreadsheets](https://utilitypot.modepot.io/tools/compare-spreadsheets/): Compare CSV/XLSX tables by a unique key and download a difference report. Browser-local; no file upload or AI. Compare stored values/formula text, not formatting or recalculated results.
- [CSV to nested JSON](https://utilitypot.modepot.io/tools/csv-to-nested-json/): Group repeated CSV rows into nested JSON and choose which fields stay together. Browser-local; no AI or upload.
- [Fix mixed spreadsheet dates](https://utilitypot.modepot.io/tools/fix-excel-dates/): Clean up supported date text and keep unclear or invalid values visible. Browser-local; no AI.
- [Find a meeting time](https://utilitypot.modepot.io/tools/meeting-time-finder/): Compare availability across cities and download a calendar event. Browser-local; timezone-aware calculations.
- [JSON to CSV](https://utilitypot.modepot.io/tools/json-to-csv/): Turn JSON records or one object into CSV for a spreadsheet. Browser-local; no AI or upload.
- [When will this cron run?](https://utilitypot.modepot.io/tools/cron-explainer/): Explain five-field cron and show the next five runs in a separate display timezone, including dates and UTC offsets. Browser-local, no AI; preview only, not a scheduler.
- [Extract names from text](https://utilitypot.modepot.io/tools/entity-extractor/): Extract people, organizations and custom categories from text up to 2 MiB. Review exact source mentions and corrections.
- [Text to Mermaid flowchart](https://utilitypot.modepot.io/tools/text-to-mermaid/): Turn up to eight listed steps into an editable, exportable flowchart. Bounded AI proposes interpretation; rendering is local.
- [Ask a webpage](https://utilitypot.modepot.io/tools/ask-a-webpage/): Find exact passages in pasted text or public HTTP/HTTPS pages. Blocked or unsupported pages require pasted text. Bounded AI selects evidence.

## Boundaries
Server-side Jev only; credentials never belong in frontend bundles. Screenshot OCR, manual image redaction, keyed CSV/XLSX comparison, CSV/JSON conversion, date cleanup, cron previews and meeting calculations run locally and never call Jev. Recognition assets download from this site and may be cached; images and results are not stored as input history. Only entity extraction, flowchart interpretation and webpage evidence selection use Jev, with disclosed bounded context and consent. There is no visitor-facing execution-mode chooser or silent fallback. No accounts or stored input histories. Anonymous, opt-out-respecting page/coarse-action analytics exclude submitted inputs, provider results and output. Entity extraction: source text up to 2 MiB; results require review and may miss or misclassify names. Mermaid: reviewed flowcharts, up to eight source steps. Webpage answers are exact excerpts, not generated explanations; URL reading accepts public HTTP/HTTPS hostnames with URL/DNS safety checks on every redirect and bounded public-egress fetching. Blocked, JavaScript-only, PDF or unsupported pages require pasted text. No independent truth guarantee. AI launch needs a server secret, rate-limit bindings and provider-side spend caps. See /privacy/.
